Position Summary:

Under the general supervision of the Engineering management, cares for hospital grounds by properly maintaining outside building areas in all weather conditions.  Responsible for mowing grass, trimming shrubs and for maintaining inventory of salt and all lawn care products.  Maintains and performs repairs on grounds equipment. 

Qualifications:

Required:

  • High School Diploma or equivalent
  • Six months previous experience operating commercial grounds equipment
  • Must possess valid State of Michigan license
  • Must meet approval by insurance carrier to drive hospital vehicles
  • Ability to perform small engine repair

  • Ability to read blueprints/diagrams

     

Preferred: 

  • Associate degree
  • Two years of job related experience.
  • Master Gardener certification
